example.platform: macOS outbound controller with a separately managed Windows 11 target
example.scope: one persistent localhost SSH tunnel, one bounded Finder automount helper and direct SFTP access to one dedicated Windows exchange folder
managedTargets: one fixed empty pause marker below one dedicated user application-support directory after a failed mount
preservedState: the accepted Tailscale Grant remains exactly TCP 22, 3389 and 21118
all Windows Firewall rules and the existing SMB server listener
Tailscale clients, DNS, routes, exit-node state and Tailscale SSH
OpenSSH authentication, RDP, RustDesk, Codex, Git, other projects, office and admin-project access
Mac inbound SSH, Keychain, Finder preferences and unrelated mounts
all files in the remote exchange folder

automountAgent.label: com.aidev.codex-bridge.smb-automount
automountAgent.oneAttemptPauseMarker: fixed empty user-owned file; contains no identifier or credential

lifecycle.prepare: require strict SSH, remote localhost SMB reachability through SSH, exact pair, absent pair or the exact previously managed tunnel-only upgrade state, safe automount pause state, and no local listener collision
lifecycle.build: build the exact nix-darwin target from the clean task commit before switching
lifecycle.apply: apply only the exact clean commit through typed aid-admin apply-system
lifecycle.doctor: require both exact user LaunchAgents, immutable automount helper identity, safe pause state, running ssh process, localhost-only listener, direct strict SSH, remote loopback SMB, active Finder mount and bounded SFTP sentinel round-trip
lifecycle.idempotence: repeating the exact commit through aid-admin preserves the current system generation
lifecycle.rollback: apply one new exact disabled-state successor commit that removes only both LaunchAgents, the localhost tunnel and an exact empty lifecycle pause marker; never remove keys, credentials, Windows data, share or firewall state
lifecycle.failure: stop without Tailscale or Windows mutation; a post-apply doctor failure requires the exact disabled-state rollback commit
